hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */docs/specs/*) r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$r" || exit 0; out=$(npm run --silent spec:check 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 2; };; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */docs/*.md) r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$r" || exit 0; out=$(node tools/check-doc-links.mjs --baseline 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 2; };; esac
